Frame critique: The desktop lead cards retain their hierarchy and the added rows distinguish booking, dependency, editing, and board workflows at card size. On phones the longer list takes more scrolling. Titles stay readable and consistently placed, while some descriptions truncate to one line.

## Cold look

Two independent readers scored the unlabelled screenshots in opposite orders, without session context. Both preferred the candidate.

| Order shown | Dev score | Candidate score | Observation |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Dev, candidate | 7.5/10 | 8/10 | The larger desktop groups preserve the lead hierarchy and add distinguishable examples. The shorter dev lists are quicker to scan on a phone. |
| Candidate, dev | 7/10 | 8/10 | Specific titles make capabilities easier to find. On phones the added cards require further scrolling, and titles carry more of the explanation. |

## Deltas from ticket

- Every planning card opens in Neo Dark, matching its cover. Five additional records now carry the dark query in all four build URLs. Visitors can still switch themes inside the examples. Both hero recipes can launch directly in Neo Dark.
- Four recipes use the full-viewport mode: `scheduler-event-editor`, `gantt-task-columns`, `board-card-editor`, and `board-big-data`. Board Big Data uses a 1440 × 810 viewport to include all five columns. The output remains 1280 × 720.
- `gantt-dependencies` uses Vega’s clarified `lookFor` wording for the finish-edge handle and where the drop happens. [Source wording](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/21613#issuecomment-7057267379)

- The final integration regenerates SEO from the combined sources. The route inventory remains 392, and only catalog metadata differs from the current `dev` SEO artifact.

## Test Evidence

81 local unit tests, 30 Portal browser tests, and SEO verification passed. All five changed dev links opened in Neo Dark with a light system preference. The updated Scheduler and Gantt hero recipes produced byte-identical copies of the published JPEGs without menu clicks. The full-page frames decoded every cover at both widths.

## Post-Merge Validation

Verify the published catalog pages and Board Big Data link on the Engine 14 deployment when it is cut.
